semantic_primitive: One breached original clause × one accepted mandate -> CARRIES or DOES_NOT_CARRY.

frontend.identity: liability command center with horizontal protocol dock, orbital mandate-custody map, telemetry stack, vertical protocol ledger, and responsibility matrix
frontend.palette: deep navy, cyan/cobalt, periwinkle/ice-blue; coral reserved for breach states
frontend.completed_action_behavior: completed finalized writes are removed from active action surfaces and replaced by read-only completion states
frontend.wei_precision: native values handled as bigint / decimal strings; no JavaScript Number conversion for wei
frontend.write_success_rule: present failure execution enum rejects; absent StudioNet enum requires action-specific finalized-state postcondition
frontend.logo_svg: public/logo.svg (two linked rings; matches application header)
frontend.transaction_submission_lock: single in-flight mutation; controls lock immediately and remain locked through finalized-state verification; duplicate writes are rejected in the wallet/RPC adapter
